chunks: Mina was named Mina because Jibril عليه السلام came to Ibrahim عليه السلام and said to him, “Wish, O Ibrahim.” It used to be called Munā, then the people named it Mina.

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Ibrahim, the Prophet addressed in this account
key_terms.تَمَنَّ: Wish or desire; the word linked here to the naming of Mina
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلَ: Jibril, the angel who addressed Ibrahim عليه السلام
key_terms.مُنًى: An earlier form of the place-name mentioned in the narration
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, the sacred location associated with the rites of hajj

ai.seo_question: Why was Mina given the name Mina in the hajj tradition?
ai.summary: This narration explains the naming of Mina by linking it to an encounter between Jibril عليه السلام and Ibrahim عليه السلام during the rites of hajj. It presents the place-name as originating from the command to wish or desire, preserving a sacred historical memory connected to the prophetic tradition.
